result.reason: Although subsection (d) adds the requested categories of third-party Vendor indemnity and generally standard claim procedures, it appears subject to Section 7's ordinary liability cap and does not provide the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. The redline also adds an unrelated bilateral attorneys' fees waiver, materially changing litigation economics without playbook support. Duplicated subsection (c), repeated section headings, and conflicting numbering further undermine drafting quality.
